headline: BlueQubit Joins Qedma, IBM and RIKEN in a Landmark Quantum Advantage Result
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, July 30, 2026--When will meaningful applications of quantum computers arrive? The standard answer has been at least five to ten years, while we wait for fully fault-tolerant hardware with millions of qubits. A new landmark study disagrees, saying Quantum Advantage is already here.
